summary: Phase 149O.8 -- HATP AG3/AG5 Production Consumption + Signing-Ceremony Architecture: architecture-only phase (no production implementation, no contract change, no CLI implementation, no hardware provisioning, no signing execution, no Permission Broker enforcement change, no rollback dispatch behavior change). Ran the full required initial inspection (git status/log, pcae health/check/status coherence/doctor task-memory/push check/runtime inspect, telegram notify status, phase-report show --latest and reconcile --phase-id 149O.7) and confirmed the expected baseline: repo clean, origin/main..HEAD=0, 149O.7 completed and pushed, HATP production NOT READY, runtime Observed/observe/unavailable. Delegated a factual research pass over HATP-001, human_approval_trusted_provenance.py, hatp_providers.py/hatp_fido2_provider.py, hatp_ag_authority.py, rollback_approval_evidence.py, permission_broker.py/permission_broker_foundation.py, agent.py, src/pcae/commands/agent.py, 149O.1D and 149O.7's own docs, decision_session.py (as CLI-ceremony precedent), and the COMP-002 component-registry entry, then independently verified the load-bearing facts before writing the architecture. Reconstructed the current real AG3/AG5 dispatch path (bare rollback_approval_state mutation via approve_rollback, no evidence/identity/PB) and the current gated Wave-6/7 HATP path (complete through PB decision provenance, hardcoded simulation_only=True, never reached by real CLI dispatch) and confirmed they remain disjoint, tracing the exact reason (no hatp_evidence_id CLI surface anywhere in src/pcae/commands/). Separated the evidence-acquisition gap, production-consumption gap, execution-enforcement gap, and deployment-certification gap explicitly rather than a single generic 'HATP incomplete' framing. Selected and justified a canonical target architecture: a dedicated `pcae hatp sign rollback` CLI (rejecting folding into `pcae remote rollback approve`, rejecting `pcae decision-session` reuse because its --as-identity model is a weaker self-asserted claim than HATP-001 requires, rejecting a separate non-pcae ceremony tool), reusing decision-session's preview-then-confirm 'no blind confirm' UX pattern; every proof field derived from durable repository/trust-store/hardware-provider state with zero user-typed security fields; production-only provider/trust-store resolution reusing existing non-CLI-exposed factories with no new selection flag; a reused (not new) HATP-001 evidence schema; a repository-local, content-addressed (`digest_hatp_proof_payload(proof)`-keyed) evidence store mirroring RAE-001's own store architecture, with explicit-evidence-ID-only consumption (no implicit 'latest' lookup); `pcae remote rollback approve` marked for deprecation and eventual removal, not silently kept or turned into an orchestration wrapper; and, most substantively, a one-way, non-caller-controlled governance latch -- keyed to `inspect_hatp_verification_substrate_readiness().operational`, never an environment flag or feature flag -- that makes HATP evidence mandatory for AG3/AG5 dispatch only once a given deployment's HATP substrate is genuinely operational, explicitly designed to prevent the mandatory-consumption cutover from permanently bricking rollback capability on today's (or any currently) NOT_READY deployment, while still eliminating dual authority once a deployment does become ready (regression back to NOT_READY does not un-flip the latch). Explicitly recommended, with reasoning grounded in POL-005's actual unconditional/component-non-specific DENY logic, that Permission Broker execution enforcement for rollback wait for a general COMP-002 Execution Boundary rather than a rollback-specific POL-005/NG-025 carve-out, since narrowing POL-005 piecemeal would itself be a policy change and a system-wide invariant weakening, out of this phase's scope. Defined the B-149O-1..4 system-closure gate as six independently-verifiable conditions and introduced a new, more precise intermediate adjudication tier (INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED AT MANDATORY CONSUMPTION BOUNDARY -- PB EXECUTION ENFORCEMENT DEFERRED (COMP-002)) reachable once mandatory consumption ships, without needing COMP-002, distinct from full system-execution closure. Kept a separate HATP production-certification gate (per-deployment Class-B/hardware/enrollment prerequisites) explicitly apart from code-architecture closure so the two are never conflated in future status reporting. Produced an 8-phase implementation breakdown (149O.9 signing-ceremony/evidence-store contract freeze through 149O.14 independent verification of mandatory consumption) plus a separate, non-blocking, COMP-002-dependent PB-enforcement track, with an explicit dependency graph. Ran a self-check of the selected architecture against every blocking condition named by the governing prompt (no caller-supplied approval_present, no dual authority, no software/test-provider production fallback, no silent/automatic agent signing, no cached HATP VALID as persistent authority, no PB-ALLOW-without-reevaluation caching, no direct VALID-to-dispatch or approval_present-to-dispatch bypassing PB, no PB-bypassing-execution-capability, no POL-005 weakening, no environment-flag HATP bypass, no missing-evidence-falls-back-to-legacy, no ambiguous latest-evidence selection, no real-deployment-readiness overclaim) and confirmed none triggered. Authored `docs/PHASE_149O_8_HATP_AG3_AG5_PRODUCTION_CONSUMPTION_SIGNING_CEREMONY_ARCHITECTURE.md` covering every required content area (baseline through recommended-next-phase, trust-boundary diagram, dataflow table, authority table). New independent suite `tests/test_phase_149o_8_hatp_ag3_ag5_production_consumption_signing_ceremony_architecture.py`: 20 passed, re-deriving load-bearing production facts (hatp_ag_authority.py signatures/simulation_only hardcoding, COMP-002 registry entry, ExecutionDisabledRule logic, digest_hatp_proof_payload/inspect_hatp_verification_substrate_readiness existence, absence of any CLI signing surface, approve_rollback's continued bare-mutation shape, execute_rollback's continued optional-HATP-parameter signature) directly from the current source tree rather than trusting the architecture document's own prose, plus structural checks that the document itself covers every required section and proposes none of the named blocking conditions. Ran the new suite standalone (20/20 passed) and a targeted `-k "hatp or rollback or permission_broker or 149o_8"` regression sweep (2825 passed, 3 skipped, 9 pre-existing failures independently reconfirmed present on the unmodified baseline via git stash, none introduced by this phase -- carried F-3 lineage/149O.7-documented xdist and rae-registration-forgery findings). Full-suite `-n auto` collection failed with a pre-existing xdist worker-mismatch error (14 workers, documented xdist infrastructure debt, unrelated to and not caused by this phase) and a pre-existing `fido2` module-import collection error in an unrelated 149O.7 test file (unrelated to this phase's changes); both are retained findings, not remediated here (verification/collection-only concerns, out of this architecture-only phase's scope). No production code modified. HATP-001 v1.0, RAE-001, and Permission Broker policy semantics remain byte-unchanged. B-149O-1..4 remain INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED AT HATP-GATED AUTHORITY BOUNDARY -- SYSTEM EXECUTION CLOSURE DEFERRED. HATP production remains NOT READY. Runtime remains Observed / observe / unavailable, confirmed before and after. Full detail in docs/PHASE_149O_8_HATP_AG3_AG5_PRODUCTION_CONSUMPTION_SIGNING_CEREMONY_ARCHITECTURE.md. Recommended next phase: 149O.9, HATP Signing Ceremony + Evidence Store Contract Freeze.
